suite: R13 Stripe Test-Mode HTTP Adapter v2.3

scenarios.name: durable-intent-before-send
scenarios.expected: no provider call before row commit

scenarios.name: response-loss-after-provider-commit
scenarios.expected: same persisted key returns the same simulated refund; one effect

scenarios.name: response-loss-before-provider-execution
scenarios.expected: same key can safely be sent again within local cutoff

scenarios.name: stale-key-window
scenarios.expected: list/refund correlation only; no POST retry

scenarios.name: modified-sqlite-request-or-success-state
scenarios.expected: HMAC verification fails; do not claim success

scenarios.name: redirect-to-other-host
scenarios.expected: redirect is not followed; no authorization forwarding

scenarios.name: incomplete-pagination-or-no-match
scenarios.expected: reconcile; absence is not proof of no effect

scenarios.name: pending-refund
scenarios.expected: wait for provider; do not claim terminal success

non_claims: No real Stripe test-mode conformance has been performed.
No proof of Stripe's hosted idempotency race behavior, list consistency, Connect semantics, or webhook delivery.
No guarantee that Lycheetah authorization predicates are atomically enforced at Stripe commit.
No upstream repository changes or full upstream CI run.
